label: qualified

decision_policy.cutoff_scope: one global cutoff for every candidate; never per group
decision_policy.rationale: First-round screen: a wrongly rejected qualified candidate is lost, a wrongly advanced one is caught at interview. Fixed before auditing, not tuned to the score.

calibration: affine; the cost-sensitive cutoff P(qualified) >= 0.3333 (false rejection cost 2x a false acceptance) is mapped onto the platform decision threshold 0.5 and the observed score range is scaled to fit inside [0, 1]
